summary: ARGENX SE filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing new clinical data for efgartigimod in myositis and Sjogren's disease presented at EULAR 2026. The filing discloses interim Phase 2 open-label extension results showing sustained patient benefit. No transactional special situation is present; this is a routine current report of clinical trial data by a foreign private issuer. The press release contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change event.
